d:
Ranchi RIMS Land Scamrajdhani ranchi ke rims ke lie adhigrahit jamin ke pharjivare ke mamle men ACB ne tabartor karravaee ki. IAS adhikari manoj kumar ranjan samet giraphtar sabhi 7 adhikariyon ke thikanon par chhapemari ki gaee. ACB ki tim jamin se jure kagjat samet any sabuton ki chhanbin kar rahi hai. adhigrahit jamin ko pharji dastavejon aur rikord men herapheri ke jariye niji sanpatti ke rup men darshane ka prayas kiya gaya tha, haeekort ke aadesh par iski janch ki ja rahi hai.
